thread:
DePaul's Loop campus has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk than any other big Illinois university, three times as many as Northwestern.

Every Illinois university with 10,000+ students:

1. DePaul (Loop campus): 488
2. Northwestern: 162
3. UIUC: 109
4. UIC: 85
5. Loyola Chicago: 72
6. Northern Illinois: 42
7. Illinois State: 40
8. UChicago: 25
9. SIU Carbondale: 19
10. SIU Edwardsville: 0

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/il

How to tell a good burger before you order:

Look at the patty. A thin patty pressed hard on a hot griddle gets a dark, crispy crust, and that crust is most of the flavor.

Three more signs:

- Beef ground in-house (about 20% fat)
- A soft, toasted bun that isn't twice the height of the patty
- Three or four toppings, not seven

First visit? Order the plain cheeseburger. It's the only way to judge the kitchen.

More on burger styles: https://www.savorscout.net/food/burgers
